setup: Cramer's rule: \([[var]]\) is the determinant of the coefficient matrix with the [[col]] column replaced by the right-hand side, divided by the determinant of the coefficient matrix.

steps.say: The determinant of the coefficient matrix: \([[a]]\cdot [[d]] - [[b]]\cdot [[c]] = [[det]]\).
Replace the [[col]] column by the constants, \([[replaced]]\), and take its determinant: \([[numer]] = [[detv]]\).
